task.instructions:
Create a dark-themed violin plot to compare the total bill amounts by day of the week from a CSV file named "data.csv" which includes columns "total_bill", "tip", "sex", "smoker", "day", "time", and "size". The plot should clearly distinguish between smokers and non-smokers using a green color for smokers and grey for non-smokers. Include split violins to show this distinction, and make sure the plot represents data quartiles inside each violin.
Requirements:
- Show a legend distinguishing smokers from non-smokers.
- Give the chart a title.
- Label the y axis.
- Make the figure 10 by 6 inches.
- Rotate the x tick labels by 30 degrees.
Save the figure as figure.png.

{"command": "cat <<'EOF' > create_violin_plot.py
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib

# Set dark theme
plt.style.use('dark_background')

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create the violin plot
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

# Create split violin plot with smokers (green) and non-smokers (grey)
parts = ax.violinplot(
    [df[df['smoker'] == 'Yes']['total_bill'], 
     df[df['smoker'] == 'No']['total_bill']],
    positions=[1, 2],
    showmeans=False,
    showmedians=False,
    showextrema=False,
    widths=0.6,
    split=True
)

# Set colors: green for smokers, grey for non-smokers
parts['bodies'][0].set_facecolor('#00ff00')  # Green for smokers
parts['bodies'][0].set_edgecolor('#00ff00')
parts['bodies'][0].set_alpha(0.7)

parts['bodies'][1].set_facecolor('#808080')  # Grey for non-smokers
parts['bodies'][1].set_edgecolor('#808080')
parts['bodies'][1].set_alpha(0.7)

# Add quartiles (inner parts)
for i, part in enumerate(parts['bodies']):
    # Add inner quartile lines
    part.set_edgecolor('white')
    part.set_linewidth(1)
    part.set_alpha(0.5)

# Set x-axis labels
ax.set_xticks([1, 2])
ax.set_xticklabels(['Smokers', 'Non-Smokers'])

# Add title
ax.set_title('Total Bill Amount by Smoking Status', fontsize=14, pad=20)

# Add y-axis label
ax.set_ylabel('Total Bill ($)', fontsize=12)

# Rotate x tick labels by 30 degrees
plt.xticks(rotation=30, ha='right')

# Add legend
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [
    Patch(facecolor='#00ff00', edgecolor='#00ff00', label='Smokers'),
    Patch(facecolor='#808080', edgecolor='#808080', label='Non-Smokers')
]
ax.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper right')

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('figure.png', dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
print("Figure saved as figure.png")
EOF
"}

{"command": "cat <<'EOF' > plot.py
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
from scipy.stats import gaussian_kde

plt.style.use("dark_background")
df = pd.read_csv("data.csv", index_col=0)
days = ["Thur", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"]
split_col, left_val, right_val = "smoker", "Yes", "No"
colors = {"left": "limegreen", "right": "black"}
text_color = "white"

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
grid = np.linspace(0, 75, 300)
for i, day in enumerate(days):
    for side, value, colour in [("left", left_val, colors["left"]), ("right", right_val, colors["right"])]:
        vals = df[(df["day"] == day) & (df[split_col] == value)]["total_bill"].to_numpy()
        dens = gaussian_kde(vals)(grid)
        dens = 0.42 * dens / dens.max()
        if side == "left":
            ax.fill_betweenx(grid, i - dens, i, facecolor=colour, edgecolor=("black" if colour == "black" else "white"), linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.9)
        else:
            ax.fill_betweenx(grid, i, i + dens, facecolor=colour, edgecolor=("black" if colour == "black" else "white"), linewidth=0.6, alpha=0.9)
        q1, med, q3 = np.percentile(vals, [25, 50, 75])
        xs = (i - 0.2, i) if side == "left" else (i, i + 0.2)
        ax.hlines([q1, q3], xs[0], xs[1], colors="white", linestyles="dotted", linewidth=1)
        ax.hlines(med, xs[0], xs[1], colors="white", linestyles="dashed", linewidth=1.4)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(days)))
ax.set_xticklabels(days, rotation=0, color=text_color)
ax.tick_params(axis="y", colors=text_color)
ax.set_xlabel("Day of the week", color=text_color)
ax.set_ylabel("Total bill ($)", color=text_color)
ax.set_ylim(0, 70)
ax.set_xlim(-0.6, 4.3)
ax.set_title("Total bill by day: smokers vs non-smokers", color=text_color)
ax.legend(handles=[Patch(facecolor=colors["left"], label="Smoker"), Patch(facecolor=colors["right"], label="Non-smoker")], loc="upper right", frameon=False, fontsize=9, labelcolor=text_color)
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig("figure.png")
EOF
"}
